scripts.vale:sync: mkdir -p examples/sample-guides/styles docs/styles && (cd examples/sample-guides && vale sync) && (cd docs && vale sync)
scripts.prepare:docs: pnpm run verify:peers && pnpm run vale:sync
scripts.docs:compile:repo: node packages/mdcp-cli/dist/cli.js compile --config docs/mdcp.config.json --docs-root docs --warn-broken-links && node packages/mdcp-cli/dist/cli.js export --llms-index --config docs/mdcp.config.json --docs-root docs
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:check:repo && pnpm run docs:check:examples
scripts.presentation:assets: mkdir -p presentations/assets && cp docs/presentation-la-devops/assets/*.svg docs/presentation-la-devops/assets/*.png presentations/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.presentation:render: pnpm run presentation:compile && pnpm run presentation:assets && marp --html true --no-stdin --engine ./marp-engine.js presentations/la-devops-2026.md -o presentations/la-devops-2026.html
scripts.presentation:render:pdf: pnpm run presentation:compile && pnpm run presentation:assets && marp --html true --no-stdin --engine ./marp-engine.js presentations/la-devops-2026.md --pdf -o presentations/la-devops-2026.pdf
scripts.presentation:serve: pnpm run presentation:compile && pnpm run presentation:assets && marp --html true --no-stdin --engine ./marp-engine.js -I presentations --server --watch
scripts.presentation:preview: pnpm run presentation:compile && pnpm run presentation:assets && marp --html true --no-stdin --engine ./marp-engine.js -I presentations --server --watch --preview
scripts.presentation:verify: pnpm run presentation:compile && pnpm run presentation:assets && mkdir -p .tmp/slides && marp --images png --no-stdin --engine ./marp-engine.js presentations/la-devops-2026.md -o .tmp/slides/
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check
